deviceKeyId.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of a device's ECDSA P-256 public key.

pairIdHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the pair identifier; never derived from character name/world.

capabilityId.description: Opaque, high-entropy, unguessable identifier. Only its hash is stored server-side. Length varies by use: an invitationId is 128-bit (22 chars, short-lived and rate-limited so this remains adequate); other capability ids (e.g. catalog requestId) stay 256-bit (43 chars). The range accepts both.

nonce.description: 128-bit single-use request-signing nonce, base64url without padding.

aeadNonce.description: 96-bit AES-256-GCM nonce (per protocol/constants.json aead.nonceLengthBytes), base64url without padding.

proofDigestHex.description: 128-bit single-use, exact-match acceptance proof token (not itself a content hash - see acceptance.schema.json proofDigest), lowercase hex, 32 chars.

ecdsaSignature.description: Raw ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signature (r||s, 64 bytes), base64url without padding.

ecPublicKeyJwk.description: P-256 public key as a JWK, used for both ECDSA (signing) and ECDH (key agreement) device keys.

encryptedCharacter.description: collar/pairing: a code invitation's character (JCS of {name, world, triggerPhrase?}) as AES-256-GCM ciphertext under a key derived from the pairing code, which the relay never has (constants.json pairingCode).
